standards.head: Protect the harvest before it fails.
standards.name: Sovereign drought insurance
standards.ffd: Parametric cover releases funds on measured rainfall, so food reaches families within weeks of a failed season, without waiting for an appeal.

proof.label: released after the El Niño drought, for food aid to about 235,000 households

standards.si: SI reads rainfall, harvests and food prices district by district, sets the trigger and prices the cover before the season begins.
standards.advises: Nations where food is furthest from reach should buy drought insurance that releases funds on measured rainfall, with the trigger and the price of the cover set district by district before the season begins. With super intelligence, rainfall and harvests can be read field by field, so that funds reach families within weeks of a failed season, before hunger does.

standards.head: Turn cheaper debt into safe water.
standards.name: Debt-for-climate-resilience swap
standards.ffd: Guarantees replace costly debt with cheaper debt, and the savings are committed to water and sewerage.
standards.si: SI maps every household without safe water at home, prices each connection, and follows the savings into every main and treatment plant.
standards.advises: Nations where water is furthest from reach should swap costly debt for cheaper, guaranteed debt and commit the savings to water and sewerage. With super intelligence, every saving can be followed into each household connection, main and treatment plant, and the next connection planned where the need is greatest.
standards.first: a debt-for-resilience swap bound to water

standards.head: Ring-fence bond money for homes and sanitation.
standards.name: Social bond
standards.ffd: The proceeds can be spent only on eligible homes, toilets and sewers, reported to investors every year.
standards.si: SI finds the homes without a safe toilet, groups them into programmes investors can finance, and reports each unit delivered.
standards.advises: Nations where shelter is furthest from reach should issue a social bond whose proceeds can be spent only on eligible homes, toilets and sewers. With super intelligence, each unit can be planned, priced and verified, and reported to investors every year, until every family has a safe home.
standards.first: a social bond for homes and sanitation

standards.head: Finance clean power and clean cooking at national scale.
standards.name: Sovereign green bond
standards.ffd: Bond money ring-fenced for clean energy under a published framework, with every allocation reported to investors.
standards.si: SI counts the households still cooking with wood, charcoal or kerosene, prices the switch per home, and tracks every project the bond finances.
standards.advises: Nations where energy is furthest from reach should issue a sovereign green bond ring-fenced for clean power and clean cooking. With super intelligence, the switch can be priced for every household still cooking with wood, charcoal or kerosene, and every project the bond finances reported to investors.
standards.first: a sovereign green bond for clean power and cooking

standards.head: Finance learning, not only classrooms.
standards.name: Program-for-Results
standards.ffd: Each tranche of the loan is released only when pupils reach an agreed learning level, verified independently.
standards.si: SI tracks reading levels school by school, sets the targets that release each tranche, and flags the schools falling behind.
standards.advises: Nations where education is furthest from reach should borrow on a Program-for-Results basis, releasing each tranche only when pupils reach an agreed learning level, verified independently. With super intelligence, reading levels can be tracked school by school, so that every child who falls behind is reached in time.

standards.head: Let lower debt costs finance care.
standards.name: Debt-for-health guarantee
standards.ffd: A development bank guarantee cuts the cost of existing debt, and the savings are bound to the health system before they can be spent elsewhere.

proof.label: IDB guarantee, 20 years; about US$160 million of the savings for health care

standards.si: SI prices the essential services each citizen lacks, finds the costly debt to refinance, and follows every saving into clinics and care.
standards.advises: Nations where health is furthest from reach should refinance costly debt behind a development bank guarantee and bind the savings to the health system before they can be spent elsewhere. With super intelligence, every saving can be followed into clinics and care, and services planned where citizens are furthest from them.

standards.head: Let local banks lend to the enterprises that hire.
standards.name: Small-business credit guarantee
standards.ffd: A facility guarantees most of each small-business loan, so local banks lend to firms they would otherwise turn away.
standards.si: SI matches enterprises to lenders, prices the risk the guarantee must carry, and counts the jobs each loan creates.
standards.advises: Nations where livelihoods are furthest from reach should set up a facility that guarantees most of each small-business loan, so that local banks lend to the firms they would otherwise turn away. With super intelligence, lenders can assess firms that have no credit history, and every job each loan creates can be counted.
